transcription_check.scope: Faithful transcription of digital PDF, including visible defects; not archival verification.

notes.manas-2010:p0566:b001:l001: Twelve months retained rather than compressed to year.
notes.manas-2010:p0566:b001:l006: Four traditional livestock classes; not arbitrarily four individual animals.
notes.manas-2010:p0566:b001:l016: Reported speech evidential I heard preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0566:b001:l019: Асый fifth year: same edition glossary1834:l021. Colt label тай retained despite stated maturity.
notes.manas-2010:p0566:b001:l022: Тартар time to give/hand over contextual grain-for-horse exchange; not punishment invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0566:b001:l027: Кыялың өсүп чечилет hopes/mind opening; hopeful development provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0566:b001:l029: Кызыр normalized to existing Khizir spelling; visitation auspicious.
notes.manas-2010:p0566:b001:l032: Алтымыш асый literally sixty asy years/stages of maturity. Hyperbole retained, not corrected to realistic lifespan or multiplied to three hundred.
notes.manas-2010:p0566:b001:l033: Азуу сөйкөп worn molars/teeth in aging formula; literal dental sense retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0566:b001:l035: Оорук army rear/camp, not illness; same edition glossary1841:l039–041. Оорубайт will not fall ill is separate wordplay.
notes.manas-2010:p0566:b001:l040: Куптап approve/choose; connecting God’s ordinance over three verses.
notes.manas-2010:p0567:b001:l001: Казат holy war/campaign retained as narrator religious framing.
notes.manas-2010:p0567:b001:l004: Sunrise/sunset also east/west; geographical extent chosen from run context, not twelve-hour duration.
notes.manas-2010:p0567:b001:l009: Оозун жайса release mouth/bridle, idiomatic give its head.
notes.manas-2010:p0567:b001:l013: Swiftness/restlessness horse subject; following address shifts to Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p0567:b001:l015: Кыйын powerful/mighty ones, no new names supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0567:b001:l018: Зайыппуруш highest-hero honorific, translated Illustrious Champion. Same edition glossary1842:l016–019; Yudakhin via https://new.bizdin.kg/media/books/Kyrgyz-tilindegi-arabizmder-Abdiev_pdo32qX.pdf. No spurious wife-related etymology.
notes.manas-2010:p0567:b001:l022: Eighteen thousand worlds is cosmological formula; not exact geography.
notes.manas-2010:p0567:b001:l025: Каалап favor/desire; бил know/recognize. Broad address retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0567:b001:l029: Babadyykan proper name of agricultural patron; following lines explain role.
notes.manas-2010:p0567:b001:l037: Divine charge/obligation broad, not an institution.
notes.manas-2010:p0567:b001:l038: Printed көзүмүн eye retained; self-revelation escalates from eye to self on next page, not silently normalized to өзүмүн.
notes.manas-2010:p0568:b001:l002: Караган кара өзүмүн repetitive watchful/dark very self formula; not separate physical person.
notes.manas-2010:p0568:b001:l014: Кызыккан coveting/desiring; possessions supplied contextually, possible interest in combat left provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0568:b001:l017: Eighty-four champion companions preserved; aligns prior spiritual-support formula but exact identities not asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0568:b001:l019: Fire imagery explicit; wish target connection broad.
notes.manas-2010:p0568:b001:l024: Ык suitable/fit; no new magical property.
notes.manas-2010:p0568:b001:l026: You alone equal forty; not forty clones or forty new companions.
notes.manas-2010:p0568:b001:l036: Same edition glossary1842:l033 explicitly Сүт кымыран = элейип, делдейип. Rendered staring/dumbfounded, not literal milk drink.
notes.manas-2010:p0568:b001:l039: Коржокто awkward/hunched movement, posture reading provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0568:b001:l041: Saddle removed, horse bareback; source transition from beneath him preserved without invented dismount action.
notes.manas-2010:p0568:b001:l042: Айдай moonlike; open unfinished clause continues next page.
